## Problem and change

Explain the concrete problem and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue when one exists.

## Validation

Describe the checks or examples you ran and their outcomes. For implementation changes, follow CONTRIBUTING.md and include regression coverage for changed behavior.

## Scope and evidence

Note changes to contract semantics, supported observations, trust assumptions, or UNKNOWN behavior. Update the relevant documentation when those boundaries change.

- [ ] No private code, credentials, or customer data are included.
- [ ] Any third-party material and its license are identified.

Use a Conventional Commit title (for example, `fix(cli): explain missing evidence`).
